en.t_0y4usp3yndvu5: Dr. Nihaia Nafea Kabaha Biadse and the Biadse Brothers Dental Clinic team combine the latest dental technologies with gentle, personalized care — implants, porcelain veneers, cosmetic fillings, teeth whitening and braces, all under one roof.
en.t_1mzpokfpdo659: Permanent, natural-looking replacements for missing teeth — from a single tooth to a complete arch.
en.t_6t5o4v1nu8bfl: Missing teeth affect far more than your appearance — they change how you chew, speak, and feel about yourself. Using advanced implant systems and precise planning, Dr. Nihaia restores missing teeth with permanent, natural-looking solutions that function just like your own teeth. From a single missing tooth to a complete arch, we rebuild smiles that last for decades.
en.t_0ngcor0dv4ozu: Fixed implant-supported bridges that restore an entire smile — often in a matter of days.
en.t_0ywsqhb9txnhp: For patients who have lost most or all of their teeth, our full-mouth rehabilitation program offers a complete transformation. Using fixed implant-supported bridges, we restore an entire smile — often in a matter of days — giving you back full chewing function and a brand-new confidence.
en.t_579x211q4qx5b: Ultra-thin porcelain shells that perfect the color, shape and alignment of your front teeth.
en.t_e6wv8h1mn4i15: Veneers are the secret behind countless celebrity smiles. These ultra-thin porcelain shells are custom-crafted to perfect the color, shape, and alignment of your front teeth. Minimal drilling, dramatic results — a flawless smile designed around your face, not a template.
en.t_1pkbd8s1aeemv5: A complete smile makeover planned around your face, lips and personality.
en.t_753u021rric4g: Your dream Hollywood smile starts with careful planning. Dr. Nihaia combines veneers, whitening and gum shaping into one coordinated plan, previewed with you before treatment begins, so the result looks bright, balanced and unmistakably yours.
en.t_0h3v8e7xshzm1: Tooth-colored composite restorations that blend invisibly with your natural enamel.
en.t_1exx75br3bvxy: Gone are the days of visible metal fillings. Our tooth-colored composite restorations blend invisibly with your natural enamel, repairing cavities and chipped teeth while keeping your smile completely natural.
en.t_zlw9fs1dz2g2t: Safe in-clinic whitening that lifts stains several shades in a single visit.
en.t_1dsovb2k4dft6: Years of coffee, tea, and time can dull even the healthiest smile. Our professional whitening treatments — performed safely in the clinic — lift stains several shades brighter in a single visit, without harming your enamel.
en.t_0cv7nmq1tfneu: Proven, reliable orthodontics for straight teeth at any age.
en.t_1f8pnl73vgeyk: Traditional braces remain one of the most effective ways to straighten teeth and correct the bite. After a full orthodontic assessment, we design a plan that delivers the best, fastest and most comfortable result for your case.
en.t_2ihdo51us0i8f: Nearly invisible aligners that straighten teeth while fitting your lifestyle.
en.t_o23ib81spl9kl: Clear aligners gently move teeth with a series of removable, almost invisible trays. They are comfortable, easy to clean and ideal for adults and teens who want a discreet way to a straighter smile.
en.t_1flcoec5iqbn9: Gentle check-ups that make children's first dental experiences positive ones.
en.t_0jhmeibaodave: We welcome young patients with patience and a smile. From first check-ups to fluoride care and fissure sealants, we focus on prevention and on building happy, fear-free dental habits for life.
en.t_01v8tvkzsl9kb: Strong, natural-looking ceramic crowns and bridges that restore damaged or missing teeth.
en.t_0uqeqlhbyorr9: When a tooth is weakened or missing, custom ceramic crowns and bridges bring back strength, function and a natural appearance — color-matched to your smile and built to last.
en.t_0v50tda663njj: Modern, comfortable root canal therapy that saves your natural tooth.
en.t_ewrabj18o41z6: With careful anesthesia and modern techniques, root canal treatment removes infection and relieves pain while keeping your natural tooth — usually far more comfortably than patients expect.
en.t_0j8y6463mctav: Professional cleaning that keeps teeth and gums healthy between treatments.
en.t_15enlt3lultwa: Regular professional cleaning removes plaque and tartar, prevents gum disease and keeps your treatments looking their best. We also share simple home-care tips tailored to you.
en.t_0h6k0ivhqbeed: Diagnosis and treatment of gum problems to protect the foundation of your smile.
en.t_0ppjq7zp27cm1: Healthy gums are the foundation of every beautiful smile. We assess, treat and monitor gum inflammation and disease, so your teeth, implants and restorations stay secure for years.
en.t_07y4h7zg87wco: An honest assessment, photos and a clear written plan — free of charge.
en.t_03bqhlq9s4obm: Your journey begins with a free consultation. We listen, examine and photograph, then explain your options clearly with a written treatment plan and pricing — no pressure, no surprises.
en.t_12y7xtpzb1q4p: Every treatment begins with listening. A precise diagnosis, a plan designed around your goals, and modern dental techniques for results that look and feel natural.
